name: dev.ucp.shopping.fulfillment.carrier_pickup
title: Carrier Pickup Extension
description: Defines the `carrier_pickup` fulfillment method: the Business ships to a parcel locker or staffed pickup point operated by a carrier network, and the recipient collects the parcel there. Used together with the Fulfillment extension.

network_summary.title: Carrier Network Summary
network_summary.description: A carrier network the Business ships to.

network.description: Carrier network identifier, matching `network` on Carrier Point Destinations.

name.description: Buyer-facing name of the network. Plain text, no markup or links.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the countries where the Business ships to this network's points. Absent means not stated.

recipient_requirement.title: Recipient Requirement
recipient_requirement.description: Recipient data an option needs to create the shipment, and why. The requirement is met when at least one field in `fields` is present on the selected destination's `recipient`.

fields.description: Alternative `recipient` fields; any one of them satisfies the requirement. One entry means that field is required.

purpose.description: Why the option needs the data. Well-known values: `pickup_notification` (the network sends the deposit notice or the collection code there), `recipient_identification` (staff check the recipient at handover), `network_account` (the network delivers only to its registered customers). Businesses MAY use additional values with a `description`.

description.description: Buyer-facing explanation of the requirement, for example the notification channel. Plain text, no markup or links. Required when `purpose` is not a well-known value.

countries.description: Point countries this requirement applies to. Absent means all countries of the option.

point_types.description: Point types this requirement applies to. Absent means all.

carrier_pickup_option.title: Fulfillment Option (Carrier Pickup)
carrier_pickup_option.description: Fields a Fulfillment Option carries under a `carrier_pickup` method. Each option is one carrier service with its own price; the price does not depend on which point of that service is selected.

network.description: Network whose points this service delivers to. The selected point MUST belong to it.

countries.description: Point countries this service delivers to. Absent means not stated.

point_types.description: Point types this service delivers to. Absent means all.

pickup_period.description: Holding period of this service at its points.

recipient_requirements.description: Recipient data this service needs. Lists only what the service needs for delivery to a point; never a postal address of the recipient or Buyer.

carrier_pickup_method.title: Fulfillment Method (Carrier Pickup)
carrier_pickup_method.description: A Fulfillment Method, with the contract for `type: carrier_pickup`. Methods of other types keep the core contract unchanged.

destinations.description: Carrier points for this method. The Platform MAY write the point the recipient chose; the Business returns resolved points and MAY list points it suggests.

carrier_pickup_expectation.title: Expectation (Carrier Pickup)
carrier_pickup_expectation.description: Fields an Order Expectation carries when its `method_type` is `carrier_pickup`, so the Order shows the selected point, by key, name and address, before any fulfillment event exists.

point.description: The selected carrier point, with its name. Required when `method_type` is `carrier_pickup`.

name.description: Buyer-facing name of the point. Plain text, no markup or links.

destination.description: The point's address. Under `carrier_pickup` it carries at least `address_country` and `address_locality`.

carrier_pickup_fulfillment.title: Fulfillment (Carrier Pickup)
carrier_pickup_fulfillment.description: The Fulfillment object, narrowed for `carrier_pickup` methods.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.title: Checkout with Carrier Pickup
dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Checkout whose Fulfillment object is narrowed for `carrier_pickup` methods. It narrows only `fulfillment.methods[]` and declares nothing else. UCP has no way to compose an extension only when another extension is active, so this composition also applies when Fulfillment is not negotiated; a Business then MUST NOT send `fulfillment`.

dev.ucp.shopping.order.title: Order with Carrier Pickup
dev.ucp.shopping.order.description: Order whose expectations keep the selected carrier point and whose fulfillment events report deposit at, collection from and expiry at a carrier point.

networks.description: Carrier networks the Business ships to, so a Platform can offer the right point selector before Checkout.

carrier_pickup_option_composed.title: Fulfillment Option (Carrier Pickup, composed)
carrier_pickup_option_composed.description: A Fulfillment Option with the carrier pickup fields.

carrier_pickup_group.title: Fulfillment Group (Carrier Pickup)
carrier_pickup_group.description: A Fulfillment Group whose options are carrier services.
